versions.changelog:
- Added support for transcribing local video and audio files, as well as public video links.
- Added custom prompts for summaries, rewrites, quote extraction, shot breakdowns, translation, and other structured outputs.
- Added task reuse with `--id`, including `--id last`, to generate new content without re-uploading.
- Documented setup requirements, supported inputs, limitations, error handling, output behavior, and usage-based pricing.
